headline: Government announces measures against record fuel prices, abolishes excise duty on propane-butane
summary: The Bulgarian government announced measures against high fuel prices after a working meeting at the Council of Ministers. It also abolished the excise duty on propane-butane.
why: Fuel prices feed directly into transport, logistics and consumer costs, and excise changes alter the tax burden on energy products. Both affect Bulgarian inflation and business margins.
